author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 10; ensure at least four current turns classified as account_security across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer locked out of account after changing phone number

messages.content: I got a new phone last week and now I can't get into my account. The verification code goes to my old number.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can help you regain access. Could you confirm the email address on the account?
It's jordan.kim@gmail.com. I've been trying all morning and it's really frustrating.
Thank you. I've sent a one-time recovery link to that email. Please check your inbox and follow the steps to update your phone number.

variants.text: I clicked the link but it says the session expired. Can you send another one?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just make a brand new account instead.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Wait, before I do that — do you still have that winter jacket in size large? I saw it last week.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a refund while also checking order status

messages.content: I returned a blender two weeks ago and haven't seen the money back yet.
Let me look into that return for you. Could you share your order number?
Sure, it's #48291. Also, I ordered some coffee pods separately and I'm wondering when those arrive.
I see the return was received on the 3rd. Refunds typically post within 5-7 business days after that. For the coffee pods, let me check the tracking.

variants.text: It's been 8 business days now. I need this refund processed today or I'm filing a dispute.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, never mind the refund — just tell me about the coffee pods delivery.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Can you also reset my password? I keep getting locked out of my account when I check tracking.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer wants to speak to a person about damaged furniture

messages.content: My bookshelf arrived with a cracked shelf panel. I'm really not happy about it.
I'm sorry about the damage. I can arrange a replacement panel or a full replacement — which would you prefer?
Honestly, I've been going back and forth with chat for an hour. I just want a real person to handle this.

variants.text: Please transfer me to a supervisor right now. I don't want to repeat everything again.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, if you can just send the replacement panel, that's fine. I'll install it myself.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hmm, actually before that — is my account showing the right shipping address? I moved recently.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer asks about warranty coverage for a laptop

messages.content: My laptop screen flickers whenever I unplug the charger. It's about 14 months old.
That sounds like a power-related display issue. The standard warranty covers 12 months, but let me check if you purchased an extended plan.
I think I did add one at checkout. It was like thirty bucks extra.
I can confirm you have the 2-year extended care plan, so this would be covered. Would you like to start a repair request?

variants.text: Yes, please start the repair. Also, does the plan cover accidental drops or just defects?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Oh wait, I actually bought this laptop for my sister. Can I transfer the warranty to her name?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: You know what, I'll just take it to a local shop instead. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer checking delivery address before shipment

messages.content: I placed an order for a desk lamp about an hour ago. I want to make sure it ships to my office, not home.
Let me pull up that order. Could you confirm the order number or the email used?
Order #77315, email is priya.shah@outlook.com.
Found it. The shipping address on file is your home address on Maple Street. Would you like me to update it before dispatch?

variants.text: Yes, please change it to my office at 200 Harbor Blvd, Suite 4.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I don't remember placing that order. Did someone use my account?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, on second thought, just cancel the whole thing. I found a cheaper one elsewhere.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about gift card balance and then something else

messages.content: I got a gift card for my birthday and I'm trying to figure out how much is on it.
I'd be happy to check that. Could you provide the gift card number and PIN from the back?
The number is 4820-1139-7752 and the PIN is 8841.
Your gift card has a balance of $75.40. Is there anything else I can help you with?

variants.text: Great, thanks for checking. That's all I needed.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Perfect. Now, I also noticed a charge on my credit card from you guys that I don't recognize.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks. By the way, someone logged into my account from another city last night — can you check that?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer hesitates between two similar products

messages.content: I'm torn between the AeroPress Go and the regular AeroPress. I travel a lot for work.
The Go version is more compact and comes with its own mug, which is handy for travel. The regular one makes slightly larger batches.
That helps. I mostly make coffee just for myself in hotel rooms.
Then the Go would likely suit you well — it's designed for exactly that scenario, and it fits in a carry-on easily.

variants.text: Alright, I'll take the Go. Actually, wait — does it work with the metal filter from my old one?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks for the advice. I'll think about it and come back later.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Okay, I'll order the Go. But first, can you verify my saved payment method is still valid? I got a new card.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer complains about a late delivery and wants compensation

messages.content: My package was supposed to arrive Tuesday and it's now Friday. This is the second time this month.
I sincerely apologize for the delay. Let me check the current status of your shipment.
Tracking just says 'delayed in transit' with no update since Wednesday. I needed these shoes for a wedding tomorrow.
I understand the urgency. I can see it's still at the regional hub. I'll escalate this with the carrier and also offer a 10% courtesy discount on your next order.

variants.text: A 10% discount isn't enough for missing a wedding. I want a full refund and free return shipping.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Fine, but can you at least make sure my account isn't being flagged for something? I've had two late orders and I'm worried.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, is there any way to pick it up at the hub myself? The wedding is at 2pm tomorrow.
variants.label: order_logistics
